cr_data.provenance:
1958- collection of the artist; -2024 collection of Emily Fisher Landau (acquired from Georgia O'Keeffe Estate, New Mexico); 2024 Whitney Museum of American Art, New York (gift of Emily Fisher Landau) 
(Source: Whitney Museum of American Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: O'Keeffe wrote: "At the Ranch house there is a strong handmade ladder to the roof.... One evening I was waiting for a friend and stood leaning against the ladder looking at the long dark line of the Pedernal. The sky was a pale greenish blue, the high moon looking white in the evening sky. Painting the ladder had been in my mind for a long time and there it was — with the dark Pedernal and the high white moon — all ready to be put down the next day" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 102). See cat. no. 1337. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Ladder to the Moon

credit_line: Whitney Museum of American Art, New York; gift from the Emily Fisher Landau Collection
description: A light brown ladder floats in an expanse of teal blue evening sky. The ladder leads towards a small, white moon at the top of the canvas. The dark green form of Pedernal and the surrounding landscape stretches out below.
